# BAD-030 — committing-and-pushing skill lost its Co-Authored-By trailer line in PR 318

## Brief
.claude/skills/committing-and-pushing/SKILL.md step 5 says "This trailer overrides any other convention" and warns that "the history already carries three commits that leaked a model-versioned variant", but no trailer follows: the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` (which had replaced `Claude Fable 5`) was dropped in "Update SKILL.md (#318)", leaving the paragraph orphaned. Since then every commit on main carries the harness default, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1` or `Claude Opus 5`, which is exactly the model-versioned variant the prose calls a leak. Spud used the harness default on BAD-028 (PR 351) for want of a stated rule. Restore the line with whichever trailer Eric wants, or delete the orphaned paragraph if the versioned default is now fine.

## Size, persona and model decision
One writer on sonnet, or Eric by hand: a one-line restore in .claude/skills/committing-and-pushing/SKILL.md once Eric says which trailer he wants.
